search_budget.precision: Conservative elapsed-window accounting, includes intervening implementation and push; active search duration not separately instrumented. No reset and no further source search.

download_budget.web_metadata_bytes: Not measured by web connector; excluded from archive byte counter. No claim of exact total network transfer.

sources.name: DAVIS
sources.reason: Inspected rules explicitly license new annotations; source-image permission not established by the inspected material. No media downloaded.

sources.name: CDnet2012
sources.reason: Official site invites academic and industrial researchers to test change/motion algorithms on camera-captured data. Applied narrowly to local change-reference diagnostics; no blanket redistribution or production-use license claimed. No source frames committed.
sources.sampling: Selected and HEAD-probed before first new frame viewing; one fixed pair per sequence, frame 1 and frame 30. No replacements.
sources.attribution: N. Goyette, P.-M. Jodoin, F. Porikli, J. Konrad, P. Ishwar, changedetection.net: A new change detection benchmark dataset, CDW-2012 at CVPR-2012.

acquisition: Strict HTTP 206 byte ranges over official ZIPs, central directory and two named JPEG members only; CRC checked by zipfile, SHA256 retained. No complete large archive or annotation masks downloaded.
